text: An ornate, easily concealable pistol meant for disabling aggressive humans and wildlife alike at very close range. Often carried by working girls, farmhands, and shady businessmen of far-off steamworlds.\n\nTales of steamworld gunslingers would imply this weapon and ones like it are capable of occasional incredibly lucky shots.
